selections.label: NY moneyline
inputs: Payload model: P(NY win) 0.566 at home (ratings from 3 games each; DET 107.9 ortg-based margin, NY home court included), implied expected margin NY +2.1, margin sd 12.6

Jalen Duren (DET) Out, hamstring, at least two weeks (Yahoo, Oct 27 10:00 AM ET). Starting centre for DET; the model has no lineup term, so the desk adds the absence: +2.5 points to NY (a judgement inside the runbook's lineup range; a starting big, not a star)
Jose Alvarado (NY) Out, ankle: −0.5 points to NY (backup guard, small effect)
Ausar Thompson (DET) and Isaiah Joe (DET) Questionable: not adjusted (no expected-to-play source found; if both sit, the desk's number is understated)
P(NY wins) = Φ(4.1 ÷ 12.6) = Φ(0.325) = 0.627, trimmed to 0.62 for the two Questionable DET players' unknown effects on the upside
arithmetic: Desk minus no-vig: 0.62 − 0.604 = +1.6 points (inside the 8-point trigger, no re-check needed)
Break-even at 1.588 = 1 ÷ 1.588 = 0.630; EV = 0.62 × 1.588 − 1 = −1.5% (near break-even: this is a win-probability pick at a short price, not a value pick)
pros: Duren is out for at least two weeks, the one news item the model does not see, and it moves the margin toward NY
Detroit's remaining bigs are thin (Reed as the main centre), and Towns is an excellent matchup at the five
The desk's number sits close to the no-vig market (1.6 points apart), so the case rests on news the market has already priced rather than on a disagreement with it
risks: Thompson (Questionable, ankle) and Joe (Questionable, hip): if both play, DET is closer to full strength and the desk's number is too high; if both sit, it is too low
Ratings rest on three games each; the model's margin is noisy
Price: 1.588 is at break-even for the desk's number, so the EV is about zero to slightly negative; a move to NY −3.5 or shorter is no longer worth taking on this number
Alvarado's absence weakens NY's backcourt depth, not counted beyond −0.5
selections.verdict: NY moneyline at 1.588 (feed): desk chance 0.62 against a 0.63 break-even, so the edge is small. Grade B on the Duren news; take it only if NY is still 1.55 or better at tip, and drop it if Thompson and Joe are both confirmed playing and the price has not moved.

selections.label: LAL moneyline
inputs: Payload model: P(LAL win) 0.605 at home, implied expected margin LAL +3.3 (ratings from 3 games each; LAL undefeated at 3-0), margin sd 12.6
Scoot Henderson (POR) Questionable, ankle: −0.3 points expected (he may play as a bench scorer; the expected effect is discounted for the chance he plays)
Branden Carlson (POR) Questionable, concussion protocol: −0.3 points expected (same logic)
Shaedon Sharpe (POR) Out: not counted (size of his share of POR's minutes is not measured in the sources)
Carr and Thiero (LAL) Out, rookies not in the rotation: not counted
Luka Dončić not on the report and averaging 34.3 points in three games: no adjustment; LeBron James not on the roster
arithmetic: P(LAL win) = Φ(2.7 ÷ 12.6) = Φ(0.214) = 0.585, desk 0.58 (rounded down for the Henderson and Carlson uncertainty)
Desk minus no-vig: 0.58 − 0.533 = +4.7 points (inside the 8-point trigger)
pros: Lakers are home and undefeated with Dončić available and on a scoring run (34.3 points over three games)
Portland is missing Sharpe and has two questionable players in the rotation, one of them in concussion protocol
Positive expected value at the desk's number: the desk chance is above the break-even of 0.556
risks: Henderson's ankle and Carlson's concussion: if either is out, Portland's backcourt and bench depth thins, which helps LAL, but a concussion setback could also change the late rotation
Ratings rest on three games each (LAL 3-0, POR 0-3); a small sample
The desk is not using Dončić's minutes or a minutes limit: the sources read today do not give one, so the desk assumes full availability and is exposed if he is managed
Lakers' depth without Carr and Thiero is thin, though neither is in the rotation
selections.verdict: LAL moneyline at 1.80 (feed): desk chance 0.58 against a 0.556 break-even, a small but positive edge. Grade B on the Portland news; take it if LAL is still 1.75 or better at tip, and drop it if Dončić is listed as questionable or Henderson and Carlson are both confirmed to play at full minutes.
